_what: fork F5E: RULED COUPLINGS for tools/lint_citations.py. A rule here suppresses a citation from a published source into a path the public tree does not carry -- but only for a coupling somebody has DECIDED about, never for a line nobody has got to yet (that is what the Direction B ratchet in tools/data/citation_baseline.json is for).
_falsifiability: Carried over verbatim from tools/data/publish_ledger.json's arm 3: `why` is MANDATORY, and A RULE THAT MATCHES ZERO LIVE VIOLATIONS FAILS THE GATE. So a rule cannot outlive the coupling it excuses, and this file cannot quietly become the place violations go to be forgotten. Rules are evaluated in order; the first whose `sources` and `targets` both match owns the violation.
_semantics: `sources` and `targets` are fnmatch-style globs over forward-slash repo-relative paths, resolved by check_publishable.glob_re (so `*` does not cross `/` and `**` does). An empty or absent `targets` list matches any target.

rules.why: fork F5E (2026-09-16); the `blocked_on: F5M` marker was dropped 2026-09-16 at F5M S4b, which ruled on this coupling rather than removing it -- the two files stay published and their generated blocks stay un-re-authorable, so this is a permanent ruled row, not a waiting one. These two files are GENERATED: everything below their `<!-- BEGIN generated-... -->` marker is dumped out of the Ghidra database by tools/dump_symbols.py / dump_structs.py, and the citations ARE THE TEXT OF GHIDRA PLATE AND FIELD COMMENTS. Re-authoring one therefore means WRITING TO THE DATABASE -- which the fork freezes and which no F5E editor may do -- while hand-editing the emitted block instead is reverted by the next regeneration, i.e. a fix that silently un-fixes itself. The HAND-WRITTEN preambles of both files were drained normally in F5E step 5; this row covers only what the dumper emits. It is narrowed BY TARGET rather than by line number so that a NEW private target appearing in a generated block still fails. Delete this row when the DB comments are re-authored, or when the public cut stops carrying these two files.
